description: Assesses a complete background-corrected entangled-pair 6x6 coincidence observation before density-matrix reconstruction. It accepts or rejects whole four-outcome basis settings rather than individual projections, because a valid Bell state may have nearly zero complementary outcomes. A rejected assessment remains a completed protocol with its evidence published, so a parent can stop before calculating a misleading fidelity.

qualityGate.description: Explicit acceptance policy. It applies to complete four-outcome basis settings, never individual Bell-state projections.

minimumCompleteBasisCounts.description: Minimum background-corrected sum of all four outcomes in each of the nine X/Y/Z basis pairs.

maximumBasisRateRelativeStandardDeviatio.description: Maximum allowed standard-deviation-to-mean ratio across the nine complete basis rates.

link.characterization.status.entangledPa.description: Accepted or rejected quality decision, the explicit policy, each complete-basis count/rate, and rejection reasons.
